summary: Backend testing complete for Profit Scout AI. 16/16 pytest tests passing (100%). All requested endpoints verified end-to-end: JWT auth (register/login/me), mock eBay search + Gemini AI keyword suggestions, barcode mock lookup, Gemini vision image identify, profit verdict math (BUY/MAYBE/DO NOT BUY with exact fee/net/ROI math verified), history CRUD, FB-comps CRUD, full pallet lifecycle (create with total_investment=260, add item, PATCH status to sold + sold_price, dashboard reflects revenue_recovered/current_profit/break_even_percent correctly), pallet analysis (AI + deterministic fallbacks), and CSV manifest import (3 rows -> AI-parsed items inserted, retrievable via GET items). Gemini AI integration working consistently across multiple endpoints (no 502s observed in this run). One test bug (case-sensitive email assertion) was fixed in test file only — backend correctly lowercases emails as expected.

minor.issue: Computed dashboard.total_investment is added on read, but the stored pallet document's total_investment is also returned. Acceptable but slightly redundant — consistent values observed.
Uses unbounded AI call (up to 20K chars). Consider request size limit / timeout for very large PDFs. Currently fine for small files.

action_items: Frontend (React Native/Expo) was NOT tested per request — main agent or a follow-up testing pass should validate UI flows (auth screens, search/scan, profit calc, history, FB comps, pallets/manifest upload).
Optional minor cleanup: avoid returning both pallet.total_investment and dashboard.total_investment (single source of truth).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~770 lines — borderline; consider splitting into routers (auth.py, pallets.py, scan.py, ai.py) for maintainability.
Frontend env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL mentioned in review_request) — make sure frontend code reads process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
All MongoDB reads correctly project out _id. Good.
JWT secret is committed in .env; acceptable for personal-use app but should not be reused in prod.
AI calls swallow HTTPException to keep deterministic flow working (search, profit/verdict) — good defensive design.

/api/pallets/{id}/manifest: AI failure currently returns 502 (bubbled from ai_chat) which aborts the import. Could be made best-effort: fallback to naive CSV row parser when AI fails, so manifest still imports something. Currently AI worked, but worth hardening.
seed_data_creation: Seeded user tester@profitscout.app / TestPass123! verified via login. Tests create TEST_-prefixed throwaway pallets/items/history/fb-comps and clean them up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid. Re-run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. AI endpoints (/api/search, /api/scan/identify-image, /api/profit/verdict, /api/pallets/{id}/manifest, /api/pallets/{id}/analysis) call Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview and may take 5-15s; 502 'AI error' is acceptable upstream failure mode — tests skip in that case. Deterministic math (profit verdict, pallet dashboard, total_investment=260 with 200+50+10) was verified exactly.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no product bugs found. Fixed 1 test-only assertion (emails lowercased by backend).
